name: Universal Blood Type Modification
description: Suppresses expression of all major blood group antigens (A, B, Rh, and dozens of minor antigens), converting the user's blood to a universal-compatible type that can be transfused into any recipient. The modification also makes the user a universal recipient. In a city where emergency medical care often means whatever blood is available and cross-matching is a luxury, Universal Blood is a life-saving modification for both the user and anyone the user donates to. Some Universal Blood users become professional donors, selling their blood at premium rates. Emergency medical teams actively recruit UB-modified members. The modification is invisible — there are no external signs — but blood testing reveals the anomalous antigen profile immediately.
source_organism: Synthetic antigen suppression construct (no organism source)
side_effects: Slightly increased vulnerability to certain pathogens that use blood antigens as cellular barriers
Blood donation demand — UB users are constantly pressured to donate
Medical records flag anomalous blood type, requiring explanation at every medical encounter
Rare: immune system confusion during initial antigen suppression
social_perception: Altruistic and practical. Universal Blood users are valued in their communities — they're walking blood banks. Some carry donor cards identifying them for emergency harvesting (with consent). A few predatory operations kidnap UB users for forced blood farming.
story_hooks: A Universal Blood user disappears and their blood shows up in a black-market supply — someone is bleeding them for profit
An emergency medic discovers that a Universal Blood donor's blood contains genetic markers from a modification they've never had installed — their blood is carrying someone else's DNA
